mapper.sql: entry.id, entry.event_id, entry.user_id, entry.seat_count, entry.status, entry.created_at, entry.offered_at, entry.offer_expires_at, entry.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waitlist_entries WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'WAITING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM waitlist_entries WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id})

SELECT offer_seat.event_seat_id FROM waitlist_offer_seats offer_seat JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = offer_seat.event_seat_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id WHERE offer_seat.entry_id = #{entryId} ORDER BY seat.row_label ASC, seat.seat_number ASC, offer_seat.event_seat_id ASC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS entries, COALESCE(SUM(seat_count), 0) AS seats FROM waitlist_entries WHERE event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY status

SELECT event_seat.id AS event_seat_id, venue_section.id AS section_id, seat.row_label, seat.seat_number FROM event_seats event_seat JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id WHERE event_seat.event_id = #{eventId} AND event_seat.permanent_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM waitlist_offer_seats offer_seat JOIN waitlist_entries entry ON entry.id = offer_seat.entry_id WHERE offer_seat.event_seat_id = event_seat.id AND entry.status = 'OFFERED' AND entry.offer_expires_at > #{now} ) ORDER BY venue_section.display_order ASC, venue_section.name ASC, venue_section.id ASC, seat.row_label ASC, seat.seat_number ASC, event_seat.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE waitlist_entries SET status = 'OFFERED', offered_at = #{offeredAt}, offer_expires_at = #{offerExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{offeredAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING'

UPDATE waitlist_entries SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id IN ( SELECT entry.id FROM waitlist_entries entry JOIN events e ON e.id = entry.event_id WHERE entry.status IN ('WAITING', 'OFFERED') AND (e.status <> 'PUBLISHED' OR e.sales_end_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY entry.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} )
mapper.select: SELECT entry.id AS entry_id, u.email, e.id AS event_id, e.name AS event_name, e.start_time AS event_start_time, v.name AS venue_name, v.address AS venue_address, v.city AS venue_city, v.timezone AS venue_timezone, entry.seat_count, entry.offer_expires_at FROM waitlist_entries entry JOIN users u ON u.id = entry.user_id JOIN events e ON e.id = entry.event_id JOIN venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id WHERE entry.id = #{entryId}
